QUOTE: By default, the field is renamed to `private_<name>`. ... `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member #endif`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to private_<name> and shows that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes the macro expand to the bare member.
